name: 04_mini_json_parse_100kb
description: TENGO_SKIPPED: recursion depth (~2000+ frames during JSON write) exceeds tengo's ~2048 frame limit. Generate a 100 KiB JSON-like document from a deterministic LCG, parse it with a hand-rolled recursive-descent parser, return the count of object keys observed. Forbids encoding/json and Python's json module.
